page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-90-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped to 45 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core. The system is equipped with 360.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local SSDs. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In multi-core processing benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and Passmark CPU scores. It also achieves top-tier results in specialized workloads, including software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Single-core performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests. Memory performance is characterized by strong read bandwidth, reaching 6372.53 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 217.44 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, though large block write bandwidth remains in the average tier at 76.89 GB/sec.

The combination of high-density multi-core compute and 3.2 TB of fast local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance highly cost-efficient for resource-intensive, I/O-heavy deployments without the overhead of external storage. Benchmark data indicates strong suitability for database operations, with Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations both performing in the top 25%. It is also well-suited for static web serving, software compilation, and moderate LLM inference tasks, particularly prompt processing for small and medium models, though text generation for larger models is limited to average speeds.
